content: Pol da Rom dakon kɨla amɨn madep Sisa da geni nandɨsak do yagɨt
Pestus da abɨŋ gapman dakon tamo madep abɨdaŋ yɨgek wasaŋek Judia mɨktɨm kɨla agɨt. Aŋek gɨldat kapbɨ egɨ mudaŋek Sisaria kokup pap yɨpmaŋek Jerusalem wɨgɨgɨt.
Wɨgakwan mukwa sogok amɨn dakon amɨn madep kabɨ gat ae Juda amɨn dakon mibɨltok amɨn gat da Pestuskon kɨŋek Pol gen yaŋ ɨmgwit uŋun do iyɨwit.
Iyɨŋek tebaisi yaŋ yawit, “Gak nin paŋpulugaŋek yaŋbɨ uŋun amɨn yɨpba Jerusalem wɨsak.” Amɨn dɨ kosiron pasɨlek Pol aŋakba kɨmotjak do kɨlɨ yoyɨwit uŋun do aŋek gen uŋun iyɨwit.
Yaŋba Pestus da yaŋ yoyɨgɨt, “Pol Sisaria dam tebanon egɨsak. Nak Sisaria kɨlɨ uŋunjok pɨgɨkdɨsat.
Do kɨla amɨnji dɨ yopba nak gat pɨgɨno gulusuŋ kɨnda agɨt kaŋ, uŋun amɨn da gen yaŋ ɨmni.”
Pestus uŋun gat gɨldat 8 bo 10 egɨ mudaŋakwa Sisaria pɨgɨgɨt. Pɨgɨ pakgwit da wɨsa dagokdo gen pi aŋ yutnon yɨgek Pol aŋopni do yoyɨgɨt.
Yoyɨŋban aŋobɨŋ yɨpba agakwan Juda amɨn Jerusalem da pɨwit da Pol aŋgwasɨŋ akgwit. Aŋek gulusuŋ yokwisi morapmɨsi agɨt yaŋ yaŋek gen yaŋ ɨmgwit. Mani gen uŋun bamɨ mɨni ɨsalsi yaŋ ɨmgwit.
Yaŋba Pol da yaŋ yoyɨgɨt, “Nak Juda amɨn da gen tebanon gulusuŋ kɨnda dɨma agɨm. Ae Telagɨ Yut Madep do bo ae Sisa do gulusuŋ kɨnda dɨma agɨm.”
Yaŋban Pestus uŋun Juda amɨn da but galak nandaŋ ɨmni do aŋek Pol yaŋ iyɨgɨt, “Gak Jerusalem wɨgɨ nak da ɨŋamon agaki gen on yaŋ gameŋ uŋudon nandakeŋ do tagɨ nandɨsal?”
Yaŋban Pol da yaŋ iyɨgɨt, “Nak Sisa dakon gen kokwin amɨn kabɨkon akdat. Ɨdon gɨn gen yaŋ namgwit dakon geni nandagɨ. Nak Juda amɨnon gulusuŋ kɨnda dɨma agɨm uŋun gaga pakyaŋsi nandɨsal.

Nak si kɨmokgeŋ da arɨpmon suŋ kɨnda agɨm kaŋ, tagɨ nɨkba kɨmokgeŋ. Mani top yaŋek gen pikon nepgwit kaŋ, amɨn kɨnda da nak Juda amɨn da kɨsiron dɨmasi nepjak. Rom dakon kɨla amɨn madep Sisa dagɨn geno nandɨsak do nandɨsat.”
Yaŋban Pestus nandaŋ kokwin amɨn kabɨni gat gen yaŋek uŋun da kwenon yaŋ iyɨgɨt, “Gak Sisa da gengo nandɨsak do yal, do Sisakon kɨkdɨsal.”
Pestus da kɨla amɨn madep Agripa Pol do iyɨgɨt

Gɨldat kabi dɨ egɨ mudaŋek kɨla amɨn madep Agripa gat sami Benaisi gat Pestus kok do Sisaria kokupmon opgumal. Obɨŋek but galak gen iyɨŋek pi tamo on abɨdagɨl uŋun do nandando tagɨsi asak yaŋ iyɨgɨmal.
Sisaria gɨldat morapmɨ egɨpgumal do Pestus da Pol dakon geni amɨn madep iyɨŋek yagɨt, “Peliks da amɨn kɨnda dam tebanon yɨpgut da egɨsak.

Nak Jerusalem wɨgɨgɨm bɨsapmon Juda amɨn dakon mukwa sogok amɨn dakon amɨn madep kabɨni gat, ae kɨla amɨni gat da uŋun amɨn gen yaŋ ɨmgwit. Yaŋ ɨmɨŋek suŋ agɨt dakon kobogɨ nak da yaŋ dagok aŋapbo kobogɨ yokwi abɨdosak do yawit.

Yaŋba yoyɨgɨm, ‘Rom amɨn ninon gen teban kɨnda yaŋ tosok. Amɨn kɨnda da amɨn kɨnda gen yaŋ ɨmjak kaŋ, amɨn uŋun da geni yaŋ ɨmjak amɨn da ɨŋamon agek gen yaŋ ɨban kobogɨ tagɨ yosak. Yaŋ aban asi yo yokwi kɨnda agɨt kaŋ, kobogɨ do yo yokwi tagɨ aŋ ɨmɨmɨ. Yaŋ dɨma ani kaŋ, Rom nin dakon gen teban yapmaŋgaŋ.’
“Nak ɨdon opgum bɨsapmon gen yaŋ ɨmgwit amɨn nak gat kɨsi opgumaŋ. Obɨŋek nak bɨsap noknok dɨma agɨm. Pakgɨmaŋ da wɨsa dagokdo gen pi yutnon yɨgek uŋun amɨn aŋopni do yoyɨgɨm.
Aŋobɨŋakwa gen yaŋ ɨmgwit amɨn da pɨdaŋ agek yo yokwisi kɨnda agɨt do bo yaŋ ɨmdaŋ yaŋ nandagɨm. Mani dɨma.

Yum yo bamorɨ dogɨn gen emat awit. Kɨnda uŋun iyɨ Piŋkop aŋpak niaŋsi aŋek gawak ɨmaŋ uŋun do yawit, ae kɨnda uŋun amɨn kɨnda kɨmakgɨt mani Yesu do gen emat awit. Mani Pol da Yesu uŋun pɨdagɨt da egɨsak yaŋ yosok.

Nak gen uŋun dakon mibɨlɨ nandako dɨma pɨsagɨt do niaŋon da gen kokwin kɨlegɨ abeŋ yaŋ do aŋtɨdok agɨm. Do Pol yaŋ iyɨgɨm, ‘Gak Jerusalem wɨgɨ nak da ɨŋamon agaki gen on yaŋ gameŋ uŋudon nandakeŋ do tagɨ nandɨsal?’

“Yaŋ iyɨko Pol yaŋ yagɨt, ‘Nak Sisa da geno nandɨsak do nandɨsat. Do ɨdon dam tebanon egapbo don nepbɨ Sisakon kɨkeŋ.’ Yaŋ yagɨt do dam tebanon sigɨn egɨpjak do yaŋ dagagɨm. Uŋudon egakwan Sisakon kɨgɨk dakon kosit aŋnoman aŋek don yɨpbo kɨsak.”
Agripa da gen uŋun nandaŋek Pestus yaŋ iyɨgɨt, “Nak da naga uŋun amɨn dakon geni nandakeŋ do nandɨsat.” Yaŋban Pestus da kobogɨ yaŋ iyɨgɨt, “Aŋwa yaŋakwan nandakdɨsal.”

Gɨldat kɨnda do Agripa gat Benaisi gat kɨla amɨn madep ɨmalni tagɨsi paŋek opgumal. Opbal emat amɨn dakon mibɨltok amɨn madep gat, ae kokup pap uŋun dakon mibɨltok amɨn gat kɨsi muwut muwut yutnon wɨgɨwit. Aŋakwa Pestus da Pol yaŋ ɨban wɨgɨt.

Wɨŋakwan Pestus da yaŋ yagɨt, “Kɨla amɨn madep Agripa, gat ae amɨn morap on muwamaŋ ji on amɨn do koni. Juda mɨŋat amɨn morapyo Jerusalem ekwaŋ ae ɨdon ekwaŋ kɨsi da on amɨn gen yaŋ ɨmgwit. Aŋek madepsi yaŋ tɨdaŋek uŋun amɨn dɨmasi egɨpjak, nak da si aŋakgo kɨmotjak do nayɨwit.
Mani nak da gulusuŋ kɨnda si kɨmotjak da arɨpmon dɨma agɨt kagɨm. Ae iyɨ Sisa da geni nandɨsak do yagɨt, do nak da yaŋ mudaŋ ɨbo Sisakon kɨkdɨsak.

Mani ni gen bamɨ kɨnda naŋ mandaŋ yɨpbo amɨn madepninon kɨsak uŋun dɨma nandako pɨsosok. Dam tebanon amɨn kɨnda yɨpbo kɨŋakwan gen yaŋ ɨmgwit dakon but pɨso gen kɨnda gat dɨma yɨpbo kɨsak kaŋ uŋun tagɨ dɨma. Do kɨla amɨn madep Agripa, gak ae amɨn kabɨ ji kɨsi da on amɨn dakon mibɨlɨ nandani do aŋek muwamaŋ. Mibɨlni pakyaŋsi nandano pɨsaŋakwan gen bamɨ papiakon tagɨ mandakeŋ.”
